Captures a privacy-safe trace of the real VPN session: TCP/UDP connections, TCP/TLS stages, Burst queues, retries, timeouts, byte counts, and timing. While the VPN is active it exports the current session; while stopped it also runs the direct network test. Server details, passwords, secrets, and traffic contents are never recorded.
First try Telegram or a website through the VPN, then collect the report. With the VPN stopped, testing can take up to ten minutes.
